characters.earlierSummary: Demon King Ganondorf awakens when Rauru's arm and Secret Stone fall near his sealed, mummified body, then uses his Gloom to restore a healthy Gerudo form. He fights Link with Gloom weapons and projectiles and perfect dodges. In his second phase he summons four Phantom Ganons, absorbs their Gloom and knocks out the Sages with a Gloom wave. Beaten, he swallows his Secret Stone to become the Demon Dragon.

characters.continuity: Mass Effect trilogy and tie-in comics
characters.summary: Garrus Vakarian is an expert turian sniper and tactical combatant who utilizes long-range sniper rifles, assault rifles, and tech powers like Overload and Concussive Shot. Famed across the Terminus Systems as the vigilante 'Archangel', he excels at fortified defense and pinpoint eliminations.

techniques: Overload (EMP that heavily damages shields and synthetics)

mechanisms: Not established by the opened sources (fights from long range as squad support)

weaknesses: Vulnerable in prolonged hand-to-hand melee combat
Shields can be overloaded by heavy tech attacks

depictions.title: Mass Effect trilogy (as squadmate; Mass Effect 2 for powers and Archangel)

limitations: Requires elevated or entrenched sniper positions to maximize combat effectiveness
Limited close-quarters defense options
Overload's stun works only on synthetic foes whose resistances are down

sources.supports: Garrus's background as C-Sec officer, Archangel vigilante, and squadmate
Combat powers including Overload and sniper expertise
Powers Concussive Shot, Overload, Turian Rebel, Armor-Piercing Ammo; assault and sniper rifles; long/mid-range soldier; ex-C-Sec officer

characters.earlierSummary: Garrus is a turian ex-C-Sec officer and long-range soldier who uses sniper and assault rifles with the Concussive Shot and Overload tech powers. As 'Archangel' on Omega he killed so many criminals that the Blue Suns, Eclipse and Blood Pack united to kill him. He was badly wounded by a gunship before Shepard's squad finished off the gangs.
